description: This Java class configures Redis cache settings for the Thingsboard server, including connection pooling, SSL setup, and cache management.

classes.name: TBRedisCacheConfiguration
classes.description: Abstract configuration class for Redis cache integration with Spring, including SSL setup and connection pooling.

methods.name: redisConnectionFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns the Redis connection factory.

methods.name: cacheManager
methods.description: Configures and returns a transaction-aware Redis CacheManager.

methods.name: redisTemplate
methods.description: Creates and returns a RedisTemplate for Redis operations.

methods.name: registerDefaultConverters
methods.description: Registers custom converters for cache serialization.

methods.name: buildPoolConfig
methods.description: Builds and configures the Redis connection pool settings.

methods.name: getNodes
methods.description: Parses a string of Redis node addresses into a list of RedisNode objects.

methods.name: createSslSocketFactory
methods.description: Creates an SSLSocketFactory for SSL connections to Redis.

methods.name: createAndInitTrustManagerFactory
methods.description: Initializes TrustManagerFactory with CA certificates for SSL.

methods.name: createAndInitKeyManagerFactory
methods.description: Initializes KeyManagerFactory with client certificates for SSL.

methods.name: loadKeyStore
methods.description: Loads the keystore with client certificates and private key for SSL.
